items.source: The state of this class is serializable, to allow for serializing the transaction strategy along with proxies that carry a transaction interceptor. It is up to subclasses if they wish to make their state to be serializable too. They should implement the java.io.Serializable marker interface in that case, and potentially a private readObject() method (according to Java serialization rules) if they need to restore any transient state.
items.translation: 该类的状态是可序列化的，以便能够连同携带事务拦截器的代理一起序列化事务策略。子类可根据需要自行决定是否使其状态也可序列化。如果是这样，它们应实现 `java.io.Serializable` 标记接口，并且如果需要恢复任何瞬态状态，则可能需要根据 Java 序列化规则实现一个私有的 `readObject()` 方法。

items.source:
Subclasses have to implement specific template methods for specific
states of a transaction, for example: begin, suspend, resume, commit, rollback.
The most important of them are abstract and must be provided by a concrete
implementation; for the rest, defaults are provided, so overriding is optional.
items.translation: 子类必须为事务的特定状态（例如：begin、suspend、resume、commit、rollback）实现特定的模板方法。其中最重要的是抽象方法，必须由具体实现提供；其余方法提供了默认实现，因此重写是可选的。

items.source:
Transaction synchronization is a generic mechanism for registering callbacks
that get invoked at transaction completion time. This is mainly used internally
by the data access support classes for R2DBC, MongoDB, etc. The same mechanism can
also be leveraged for custom synchronization needs in an application.
items.translation: 事务同步是一种通用机制，用于注册在事务完成时调用的回调。该机制主要由 R2DBC、MongoDB 等数据访问支持类内部使用。同样的机制也可用于应用程序中的自定义同步需求。

items.source:
The default implementation throws a TransactionSuspensionNotSupportedException,
assuming that transaction suspension is generally not supported.
items.translation: 默认实现会抛出 `TransactionSuspensionNotSupportedException`，假定事务挂起通常不受支持。

items.source:
Note that exceptions will get propagated to the commit caller
and cause a rollback of the transaction.
items.translation: 注意，异常将传播到提交调用者并导致事务回滚。

items.source: The returned object should contain information about any existing transaction, that is, a transaction that has already started before the current getTransaction call on the transaction manager. Consequently, a doGetTransaction implementation will usually look for an existing transaction and store corresponding state in the returned transaction object.
items.translation: 返回的对象应包含有关任何现有事务的信息，即在当前对事务管理器的 `getTransaction` 调用之前已经启动的事务。因此，`doGetTransaction` 的实现通常会查找现有事务，并将相应的状态存储在返回的事务对象中。

items.source: Called after doCommit and doRollback execution, on any outcome. The default implementation does nothing.
items.translation: 在 `doCommit` 和 `doRollback` 执行后，无论结果如何都会调用。默认实现什么都不做。

items.source: The default implementation returns false, assuming that participating in existing transactions is generally not supported. Subclasses are of course encouraged to provide such support.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 `false`，假设通常不支持参与现有事务。当然鼓励子类提供此类支持。

items.source: The default implementation simply invokes the afterCompletion methods immediately, passing in "STATUS_UNKNOWN". This is the best we can do if there's no chance to determine the actual outcome of the outer transaction.
items.translation: 默认实现会立即调用afterCompletion方法，并传入"STATUS_UNKNOWN"。如果无法确定外部事务的实际结果，这是我们能做的最好的了。

items.source:
The returned object will usually be specific to the concrete transaction
manager implementation, carrying corresponding transaction state in a
modifiable fashion. This object will be passed into the other template
methods (for example, doBegin and doCommit), either directly or as part of a
DefaultReactiveTransactionStatus instance.
items.translation: 返回的对象通常针对具体的事务管理器实现，以可修改的方式承载相应的事务状态。该对象将直接作为参数传入其他模板方法（例如 `doBegin` 和 `doCommit`），或者作为 `DefaultReactiveTransactionStatus` 实例的一部分传入。

items.source:
The result will be evaluated according to the specified propagation
behavior for the new transaction. An existing transaction might get
suspended (in case of PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW), or the new transaction
might participate in the existing one (in case of PROPAGATION_REQUIRED).
items.translation: 结果将根据新事务指定的传播行为进行评估。现有事务可能会被挂起（在 PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW 的情况下），或者新事务可能会参与现有事务（在 PROPAGATION_REQUIRED 的情况下）。

items.source:
This method gets called when the transaction manager has decided to actually
start a new transaction. Either there wasn't any transaction before, or the
previous transaction has been suspended.
items.translation: 此方法在事务管理器决定实际开始一个新事务时被调用。要么之前没有事务，要么之前的交易已被挂起。

items.source:
A special scenario is a nested transaction: This method will be called to
start a nested transaction when necessary. In such a context, there will be an
active transaction: The implementation of this method has to detect this and
start an appropriate nested transaction.
items.translation: 特殊场景是一个嵌套事务：此方法将在必要时被调用以启动嵌套事务。在此类上下文中，将存在一个活动事务：此方法的实现必须检测到这一点并启动适当的嵌套事务。

items.source:
An implementation does not need to check the "new transaction" flag
or the rollback-only flag; this will already have been handled before.
Usually, a straight commit will be performed on the transaction object
contained in the passed-in status.
items.translation: 实现无需检查“新事务”标志或回滚专用标志；这些在此之前已经处理过。通常，将在传入状态中包含的事务对象上执行直接提交。
实现无需检查“新事务”标志；该标志此前已处理。通常，将对传入状态中包含的事务对象执行直接回滚。

items.source:
The default implementation throws an IllegalTransactionStateException,
assuming that participating in existing transactions is generally not
supported. Subclasses are of course encouraged to provide such support.
items.translation: 默认实现会抛出 `IllegalTransactionStateException`，假定参与现有事务通常不受支持。当然，鼓励子类提供此类支持。

items.source:
Invoked when the control of the Spring transaction manager and thus all Spring
transaction synchronizations end, without the transaction being completed yet. This
is for example the case when participating in an existing JTA or EJB CMT transaction.
items.translation: 在 Spring 事务管理器以及所有 Spring 事务同步结束但事务尚未完成时被调用。例如，当参与现有的 JTA 或 EJB CMT 事务时就会出现这种情况。

items.source: Should not throw any exceptions but just issue warnings on errors.
items.translation: 不应抛出任何异常，而应在出错时仅发出警告。

items.source: Make preparations for commit, to be performed before the beforeCommit synchronization callbacks occur.
